title: CEACAM6 as a machine learning derived immune biomarker for predicting neoadjuvant chemotherapy response in HR+/HER2- breast cancer.
summary: Methods 2.1: 956 HR+/HER2− GEO cases, five train/four test datasets; Results: 10-algorithm analysis, NeuralNet AUC .816; retrospective 106-patient cohort and paired IHC n=9. Biomarker association, no proven treatment benefit.
ai_technology: Machine-learning classifiers rank CEACAM6-related features and evaluate association with neoadjuvant chemotherapy response.
